title: Allowance check unavailable
summary: ZeroClick could not confirm the agent's allowance just now.
fix: ZeroClick could not confirm the allowance, and nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After and send the same call again.

title: API key required
summary: This endpoint takes a Keenable API key, and the request sent only a session token.
fix: This endpoint takes a Keenable API key, not a console session token. Send the key in the X-API-Key header and retry. Create one at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys.

title: Authentication service error
summary: The credentials could not be checked because of an error on the Keenable side; they may be fine.
fix: Your credentials could not be checked because of an error on our side; they may be fine. Wait for Retry-After and retry up to 3 times. If it keeps failing, report it with the request_id.

title: Authentication temporarily unavailable
summary: Keenable could not check the credentials just now.
fix: Keenable could not check your credentials just now; the key itself may be fine. Wait for Retry-After and retry the same request.

title: Login not approved yet
summary: The user has not approved this device login yet; "interval" is how long to wait before polling again.
fix: Poll again after the number of seconds in "interval". Keep showing the user the user_code and verification_uri.

title: Balance check failed
summary: The organization's credit balance could not be read, so the request was not run.
fix: Your balance could not be read on our side; nothing was charged and your credits are fine. Wait for Retry-After and retry up to 3 times, then report the request_id.

title: Billing record missing
summary: The organization has no balance record, so the request could not be billed.
fix: Your organization has no billing record on our side, so the request could not be billed. Retrying will not help: contact us at https://keenable.ai/contact with the request_id.

title: Card expired
summary: The card at this address has expired and was deleted.
fix: The card expired and is gone for good, so retrying returns the same 404. Run the search again for a fresh card.

title: Card not found
summary: No card exists at this address.
fix: No card exists at this address. Check that the link is complete and copied exactly. Retrying the same link returns the same 404.

title: Card storage unavailable
summary: The card could not be read from storage on the Keenable side.
fix: The card could not be read from our storage. Wait for Retry-After and retry; if it keeps failing, report it with the request_id.

title: Card too large
summary: The stored card is larger than the 1 MiB that is served.
fix: This card is larger than the 1 MiB we serve, so retrying returns the same error. Report it with the request_id.

title: Company address required
summary: Only an account signed up with a company email address can verify its domain.
fix: Domain verification needs an account signed up with a company email address (not a personal mailbox such as gmail.com). Ask a colleague who signed up with the company address to verify it. Retrying from this account returns the same 403.

title: Unprocessable entity
summary: The page was reached but has no readable text to extract.
fix: The page was reached but has no readable text to extract. Retrying will not help: fetch another source.

title: Forbidden
summary: The credentials were recognized but are not allowed, usually because the key was revoked.
fix: The credentials were recognized but are not allowed, usually because the key was revoked. Retrying with them will not help: create a new key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys, or ask a human with console access to create one for you.

title: Device code already used
summary: The device code was already exchanged for an API key; each code works once.
fix: Use the API key from the first successful poll. If you lost it, revoke it in the console and request a new code with POST /v1/auth/agent/code.

title: Wrong client for this code
summary: The device code was issued to a different client_id.
fix: Poll with the same client_id you sent to POST /v1/auth/agent/code.

title: Login declined
summary: The user declined this device login.
fix: Ask the user whether to try again before you request a new code.

title: Device code expired
summary: The device code expired or was never issued.
fix: Request a new code with POST /v1/auth/agent/code and show the user the new user_code.

title: Device login unavailable
summary: The login store did not respond, so the device login could not start or be checked.
fix: Wait for Retry-After and retry the same request.

title: DNS lookup failed
summary: The domain's DNS records could not be looked up just now.
fix: The domain's DNS records could not be looked up just now. Wait for Retry-After and verify again; if it keeps failing, check that the domain's name servers answer.

title: Verification record not found
summary: The domain does not publish the Keenable verification TXT record yet.
fix: Publish the TXT record named in "message" on the domain, wait for Retry-After (DNS changes can take a few minutes to show up), then verify again.

title: Domain already verified
summary: Another Keenable organization already verified this domain.
fix: Another Keenable organization already verified this domain, so this one cannot. Ask a colleague to invite you to that organization, or contact us with the request_id if the domain is yours.

title: Fetch mode unavailable
summary: The fetch mode this request needs is turned off on the Keenable side.
fix: The fetch mode this request needs is turned off on our side; your URL is not the cause. Wait for Retry-After and retry. If you sent live=true, retrying without it may return the indexed copy.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: The fetcher is briefly rate-limited on the Keenable side, not by your own limit.
fix: The fetcher is briefly rate-limited on our side; this is not your own limit. Wait for Retry-After and retry.

title: Fetcher unavailable
summary: Keenable's fetcher failed or could not be reached; the URL is not the cause.
fix: Our fetcher failed; the URL is not the cause and nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After and retry the same request up to 3 times, then report the request_id.

title: Forbidden
summary: The request is not allowed; the message gives the reason.
fix: This request is not allowed: read "message" for the reason. Retrying the same request returns the same 403.

title: Insufficient credits
summary: This month's free requests and the purchased credits are used up.
fix: Retrying returns the same 402 until credits are added. Ask a human with console access to buy credits at the URL in this response's billing_url field (the Billing page of the Keenable console), and to turn on auto top-up there so the balance refills itself (https://docs.keenable.ai/auto-top-up.md).

title: Internal server error
summary: Something failed on the Keenable side, usually with 500; any other 5xx without a more specific code also uses it.
fix: Something failed on our side; the request itself may be fine. Wait a few seconds and retry up to 3 times, then report it with the request_id.

title: Not a public path
summary: Paths under /internal/ are not served on the public API; the load balancer answers this itself.
fix: Use the public API under /v1 instead.

title: Authentication failed
summary: The API key is malformed, unknown or expired.
fix: The API key was not accepted. Copy the full key from https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys, or create a new one there, and retry with it in the X-API-Key header.

title: Malformed Authorization header
summary: The Authorization header is present but is not "Bearer <token>".
fix: Send the credential as "Authorization: Bearer <token>", or send a Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (create one at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys), and retry.

title: Authentication failed
summary: The bearer token is malformed or expired.
fix: The bearer token was not accepted. Sign in again for a fresh token, or send a Keenable API key from https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys in the X-API-Key header.

title: Invalid JSON
summary: The request body is not valid JSON.
fix: The request body could not be parsed as JSON. Send a valid JSON object with Content-Type: application/json (check quoting and trailing commas), or send the parameters in the query string, and retry.

title: Unknown promo code
summary: No promo code with this name exists.
fix: Check the spelling with whoever gave you the code. Retrying the same code returns the same 404.

title: Invalid parameter
summary: A parameter has a value the endpoint does not accept; "param" names it.
fix: Correct the parameter named in "param" and retry; the API reference lists the values it accepts.

title: Invalid request
summary: The request did not match the schema, or was rejected as invalid.
fix: Read "message" for what to change, and "details", when present, for each field that failed; correct the request and retry.

title: Session not accepted
summary: The session token on a console endpoint is malformed, unknown or expired.
fix: The session token was not accepted. Sign in again at https://app.keenable.ai/console for a fresh token and retry. API keys do not work on console endpoints.

title: Host not allowed
summary: The MCP request carried a Host header this server does not answer for.
fix: Connect to the MCP server at its public address (for example https://api.keenable.ai/mcp) so the Host header matches, and retry.

title: MCP message too complex
summary: The JSON-RPC message nests too deeply, has too many values or an array that is too long.
fix: Send a smaller JSON-RPC message: at most 64 levels deep, 50,000 values and 1,000 items per array.

title: Accept header not supported
summary: The MCP request did not accept both application/json and text/event-stream.
fix: Send the header "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" (the Streamable HTTP transport needs both) and retry.

title: Origin not allowed
summary: The MCP request came from a browser Origin that is not allowed, or carried several Origin headers.
fix: Call the MCP server from an MCP client or a server, not from a web page on another origin, and send at most one Origin header.

title: Method not allowed
summary: The path exists but does not accept this HTTP method; the Allow header and "allowed" list the ones it does.
fix: Send the request again with one of the methods listed in "allowed" (also in the Allow header).

title: Missing API key
summary: The request carried no API key or bearer token.
fix: Send your Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (or as "Authorization: Bearer <key>") and retry. Create a key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys.

title: Missing app identifier
summary: A keyless request did not name its app.
fix: Name your app in the X-Keenable-Title header (or the keenable_title query parameter) and retry. With an API key, call /v1/search or /v1/fetch instead, which do not need it.

title: Missing required parameter
summary: A required parameter is missing; "param" names it.
fix: Send the parameter named in "param"; it is required. Then retry.

title: Sign-in required
summary: A console endpoint was called without a signed-in session token.
fix: This console endpoint needs a signed-in session: send the session access token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". API keys do not work here; sign in at https://app.keenable.ai/console for a token.

title: Mode needs an API key
summary: The requested search mode works only with an API key or a signed-in user.
fix: This search mode works only with an API key. Send a key in the X-API-Key header (create one at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) on /v1/search, or drop "mode" (or set it to "pro" or "realtime") and retry.

title: No active organization
summary: The signed-in account has no active organization to bill.
fix: This account is signed in but has no active organization, so there is nothing to bill. Create or join an organization at https://app.keenable.ai/console, or call with an API key, then retry.

title: Not found
summary: Nothing was found for this request.
fix: Nothing was found for this request: read "message", correct it and retry.

title: Not found
summary: The site says the page does not exist.
fix: The site says the page does not exist. Retrying the same URL returns the same 404: check the URL, or use another search result.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: The per-second limit on pay-per-request access was exceeded.
fix: Wait for Retry-After and retry. For a limit that can be raised, use an API key with prepaid credits (https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) on /v1/search and /v1/fetch.

title: Bad gateway
summary: The x402 payment facilitator failed while settling.
fix: The x402 facilitator failed while settling, so nothing was returned. Wait a few seconds and retry with a new payment.

title: Payment rejected
summary: A PAYMENT-SIGNATURE was sent but the payment was not accepted; "reason" says why.
fix: Nothing was charged. Read "reason", then sign one of the "accepts" offers exactly as given (scheme, network, asset, amount and payTo) with a funded wallet and resend it in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

title: Payment required
summary: A pay-per-request endpoint (x402, or ZeroClick on /v1/zeroclick/*) was called without a payment.
fix: Pay and send the same request again: with x402, sign one of the "accepts" offers and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; through ZeroClick, retry as an agent whose allowance covers the usage. Without either, call /v1/search or /v1/fetch with an API key instead.

title: Payment settlement failed
summary: The payment was verified but could not be settled, so the result was withheld.
fix: Nothing was charged. Sign a new payment for the offer and retry; reusing the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE fails again.

title: Payment verification failed
summary: The x402 facilitator failed while verifying the payment; nothing was charged.
fix: Verification moves no funds, so the same payment is still good. Wait for Retry-After and resend the same request with the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

title: Unavailable for legal reasons
summary: Pay-per-request access is not offered in the caller's region.
fix: Pay-per-request is not offered in your region, so retrying will not help. Call /v1/search and /v1/fetch with an API key (https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) instead.

title: Payments temporarily unavailable
summary: Pay-per-request access is briefly unavailable.
fix: Pay-per-request is briefly unavailable. Wait for Retry-After and retry, or call /v1/search and /v1/fetch with an API key (https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys).

title: Forbidden
summary: The URL points to a private or non-routable address.
fix: The fetcher only reaches public http and https pages. Use a public URL; retrying this one returns the same 403.

title: Card required
summary: The promo code needs a card on file; details.checkoutUrl is where to save one.
fix: Save a card at details.checkoutUrl. The credits are added once the card is saved, and nothing is charged.

title: Card already used
summary: The card on file already redeemed this promo code.
fix: Each card can redeem a promo code once, to stop credit farming. Save a card that has not redeemed this code, then retry.

title: Promo code not active
summary: The promo code exists but is outside the dates it can be redeemed.
fix: This promo code can only be redeemed within its dates, and now is outside them; "message" says whether it is not active yet or has expired. Retrying now returns the same 403.

title: Promo code is for new accounts
summary: The promo code works only on accounts created in the last 24 hours.
fix: This code works only on accounts created in the last 24 hours, and this account is older. Retrying gives the same answer.

title: Prompt extraction failed
summary: The page was fetched, but running the prompt over it failed on the Keenable side.
fix: The page was fetched, but running your prompt over it failed on our side; the URL is not the cause and nothing was charged. Retry once. If it fails again, fetch the page without prompt and read the content yourself.

title: Page too long for a prompt
summary: The page is longer than a fetch prompt can cover.
fix: The page is longer than a fetch prompt can cover, so the same URL with a prompt fails the same way. Fetch it without prompt (max_chars caps the size), or fetch a more specific page. Nothing was charged.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: The hourly limit for keyless requests from this IP address was reached.
fix: Wait for Retry-After (up to an hour) before retrying; a retry sooner returns 429 again. To continue now instead, create a free API key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys and call /v1/search or /v1/fetch with it in the X-API-Key header: keyed requests have no hourly cap. No account yet? Sign up at https://app.keenable.ai/signup: the free API key includes 100,000 requests a month.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: The per-second limit for keyless requests from this IP address was exceeded.
fix: Wait for Retry-After and retry, or send an API key (create one at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) to /v1/search or /v1/fetch for your organization's own limit. No account yet? Sign up at https://app.keenable.ai/signup: the free API key includes 100,000 requests a month.

title: Query refused
summary: The query broke a traffic rule; "message" says which.
fix: Read "message" for the limit the query broke, change the query and retry. Sending it unchanged returns the same 400.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: The organization's requests-per-second limit, shared by all its keys, was exceeded.
fix: Wait for Retry-After, retry, and keep under your organization's per-second limit. To raise it, top up $1,000 or more within 90 days for 25 requests per second for 90 days at https://app.keenable.ai/console/billing?tab=limits; for more, talk to the team at https://keenable.ai/contact.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: Too many requests to this endpoint in a short time.
fix: Wait for Retry-After and retry, and send requests less often.

title: Request rejected
summary: The request was rejected, usually with 409 Conflict; any other 4xx without a more specific code also uses it. The message names the step to take first.
fix: The request was rejected: read "message" for the step to take first. Retrying the same request unchanged returns the same error.

title: Request body too large
summary: The JSON request body is larger than the server accepts.
fix: The JSON request body is larger than the server accepts. Send only the documented parameters, with a shorter query, and retry.

title: No such endpoint
summary: No endpoint is served at this path.
fix: No endpoint is served at this path. Check the path against the API reference at https://docs.keenable.ai/api-reference (for example /v1/search or /v1/fetch) and retry.

title: Search failed
summary: The search backend answered with an unexpected status; the cause was not identified.
fix: Search failed with an unexpected status from our backend, and nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After and retry once; if it fails again, report the request_id.

title: Overloaded
summary: Search is briefly overloaded.
fix: Search is briefly overloaded. Wait for Retry-After and retry, backing off if it repeats.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: Search is briefly rate-limited on the Keenable side, not by your own limit.
fix: Search is briefly rate-limited on our side; this is not your own limit. Wait for Retry-After and retry.

title: Search refused
summary: The search backend refused the request; "message" carries its reason.
fix: Our search backend refused this request; "message" has its reason. Change the query or the filter it names and retry. Sending it unchanged returns the same 400; if the query looks valid, report it with the request_id.

title: Search backend failed
summary: The search backend failed while answering; the request itself is not the cause.
fix: Our search backend failed; your request is not the cause and nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After and retry up to 3 times, then report the request_id.

title: Too many queries running
summary: Too many of this buyer's SELECT queries are running at once.
fix: Nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After, or for one of your running queries to finish, then send the query again.

title: SELECT switched off
summary: Paid SELECT is switched off or not deployed right now; nothing was charged.
fix: Paid SELECT is switched off on our side right now, and nothing was charged. Retrying now returns the same error: try again later, or use search and fetch in the meantime.

title: SELECT failed
summary: The SELECT service answered in a way Keenable could not use; nothing was charged.
fix: This is a fault on our side, not in your query, and nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After and retry once; if it repeats, report the request_id.

title: SELECT query failed
summary: The query is valid but failed while it ran; "message" has the reason.
fix: Nothing was charged. The query failed while it ran (see "message"). Change it, for example narrow WEB_SEARCH or simplify the extraction, using https://select.keenable.ai/guide.md, then send it again.

title: Invalid SELECT query
summary: SELECT refused the query as invalid; "message" has its reason.
fix: Nothing was charged. Fix the query using "message" and the guide at https://select.keenable.ai/guide.md, then send it again. Retrying it unchanged returns the same 400.

title: SELECT timed out
summary: The SELECT service did not answer in time, so the result was withheld; nothing was charged.
fix: Nothing was charged. A long query is the usual cause, so narrowing it (add LIMIT, filter WEB_SEARCH, or set show_preview to true) is the surest fix. If the query is already small, the service was slow: retry once later.

title: SELECT unavailable
summary: The SELECT service failed or could not be reached; nothing was charged.
fix: Nothing was charged. Wait for Retry-After and send the same query again, at most 2 more times; then report the request_id.

title: Not configured
summary: The feature this endpoint needs is not configured on this server.
fix: This endpoint is not configured on our side, so retrying will not help until we fix it. Report it with the request_id.

title: Sign-in required
summary: This MCP endpoint, or the WebQL mode requested on it, needs a signed-in user or an API key.
fix: Connect with OAuth sign-in, or send a Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (create one at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys), and retry. Keyless MCP works on the default endpoint without WebQL mode.

title: Polling too fast
summary: The device login was polled again before the interval passed; "interval" is the new, longer interval.
fix: Wait the number of seconds in "interval" between polls from now on.

title: Upstream forbidden
summary: The site refused the fetcher, for example with a bot check.
fix: The site refused the fetcher, for example with a bot check or an access rule. This is not about your API key, and retrying the same URL will not help: fetch another source for the same content.

title: Unprocessable entity
summary: The site answered with an error status for this URL.
fix: The site answered with an error status for this URL. Retrying the same URL will not help: check the URL or fetch another source.

title: Unprocessable entity
summary: The page needs a login or a subscription.
fix: The page needs a login or a subscription, so there is no content to return. Retrying will not help: fetch another source.

title: Rate limit exceeded
summary: The target site rate-limited the fetch.
fix: The target site rate-limited the fetch. This is not your Keenable limit: wait for Retry-After and retry, or fetch another source.

title: Gateway timeout
summary: The page took too long to respond.
fix: The page took too long to respond. Retrying can help: wait a few seconds and retry up to 3 times, then try another URL.

title: Bad gateway
summary: The fetcher could not reach the page.
fix: The fetcher could not reach the page: a connection, DNS or TLS failure, or a server error on the site. This is often transient: wait a few seconds and retry up to 3 times, then try another URL.

title: Unprocessable entity
summary: The site served a different page than the one requested.
fix: The site served a different page than the one requested, such as a redirect to its home page. Retrying will not help: check the URL or fetch another source.

title: Time Machine not enabled
summary: The request used Time Machine (query_time), which is not enabled for the organization.
fix: Time Machine is not enabled for your organization, so retrying returns the same 403. To use it, contact Keenable support at support@keenable.ai and ask them to enable Time Machine for your organization; include the request_id from this response. For current results meanwhile, drop query_time and call /v1/search or /v1/fetch.

title: Authentication required
summary: The request was not authenticated; the message names what is missing or wrong.
fix: Read "message" for the credential that is missing or was rejected, sign in again or send a valid key, and retry.

title: Bad request
summary: The request has a parameter the endpoint does not know; "allowed" lists the ones it does, and "did_you_mean" maps a name that is close to a supported parameter to that parameter.
fix: Remove the unknown parameter, or rename it to one of the parameters listed in "allowed", and retry.

title: Unknown tool
summary: The MCP tools/call named a tool this server does not have.
fix: Call tools/list for the tools this server offers, and call one of them by its exact name.

title: Unprocessable entity
summary: The request was understood but could not be completed.
fix: The request was understood but could not be completed: read "message". Retrying the same request returns the same 422.

title: Unsupported body encoding
summary: The request body uses a Content-Encoding or charset the server does not read.
fix: Send the JSON body in UTF-8, uncompressed or with gzip, deflate or br Content-Encoding, and retry.

title: Unsupported grant type
summary: The device login poll named a grant_type other than the device code grant.
fix: Send grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code with your device_code and client_id.

title: Login code not found
summary: No pending login matches this user_code; it may be mistyped or expired.
fix: Check the code shown by the agent or CLI. If it still fails, run `keenable login` again or ask the agent for a new code.

title: Login code already used
summary: This login was already approved.
fix: This login was already approved, so the agent or CLI already has its key. To log in again, run `keenable login` again or ask the agent for a new code.

title: No stored version
summary: Time Machine has no copy of this page at or before query_time.
fix: No copy of this page is stored at or before query_time. Try a later query_time, or check that the URL is correct. Retrying the same request returns the same 404.

title: zdr_prompt_unsupported
summary: The zero data retention policy does not allow fetching with a prompt.
fix: This request runs under a zero data retention policy, which does not allow fetching with a prompt. Remove the prompt parameter. Retrying the same request returns the same 400.

title: zdr_unsupported_profile
summary: The zero data retention policy does not allow the data sources this request needs.
fix: This request runs under a zero data retention policy, which does not allow the data sources it needs. Retrying the same request returns the same 400.

title: ZeroClick allowance denied
summary: ZeroClick did not authorize this agent to pay for the call; "reason" has its reason.
fix: Nothing was charged. Top up or raise this agent's allowance on ZeroClick, then retry; ZeroClick's reason is in "reason". Without ZeroClick, use an API key (https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) on /v1/search and /v1/fetch.

title: ZeroClick request id missing
summary: A signed ZeroClick call has no zc-request-id header.
fix: Send the zc-request-id that ZeroClick issued for this call, include it in the signature, and resend.

title: ZeroClick signature expired
summary: The zc-signature timestamp is too far from the server clock.
fix: Sign the request again with the current time and resend it. If it repeats, the signer's clock is off: sync it with NTP.

title: ZeroClick signature invalid
summary: The zc-signature does not match the request that was sent.
fix: Sign the exact method, path, body, request id and agent id you send, and resend. A proxy that rewrites the path or the body breaks the signature.

title: ZeroClick signature malformed
summary: The zc-signature header does not parse as t=<unix seconds>,kid=<key id>,v1=<64 hex>.
fix: ZeroClick builds this header. Rebuild it as t=<unix seconds>,kid=<key id>,v1=<64 lowercase hex>, or, if you called through ZeroClick, report it to ZeroClick with the request_id.

title: ZeroClick signature missing
summary: A ZeroClick path was called without the zc-signature header.
fix: This path accepts only calls that ZeroClick signs and forwards. Buy and call it through ZeroClick; to pay per request with a wallet use /v1/x402/*, or use an API key (https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) on /v1/search and /v1/fetch.

title: ZeroClick signing key unknown
summary: The zc-signature names a key id Keenable does not hold.
fix: Sign with a current ZeroClick signing key. After a key rotation, ask Keenable to load the new key, then retry.
